To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the key building blocks to enable content-centric networking in today’s Internet are: a) the ability to efficiently locate and access content; b) a mechanism to efficiently replicate content in the network; c) a mechanism for content caching; d) an efficient way to manage content distribution.
• Content-centric networking is a key research direction for future Internet.
• The main building blocks of a content-centric Internet are content management, content delivery, and content access.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the Internet as a content-centric network.
how to design a network infrastructure that is able to support the generation, distribution and access of content in an efficient, effective and secure way.
understanding the impact of the Internet on society, and the impact of society on the Internet
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, while the Internet has been designed to support reliable host-to-host communication, it has been used to support content distribution.
the Internet is a network for content.
the Internet has evolved from a network designed for host-to-host communications to a content-centric one, where the content is at the core of networking.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the Internet is moving from a network that was conceived to provide host-to-host communication towards a network that is mostly devoted to support the efficient generation, sharing, and access to content, i.e. the Internet is moving towards a content-centric network.
content-centric technologies have the capability of providing efficient and effective solutions to the content distribution problems.
content-centric technologies are the key building block for the current Internet.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Future Internet should be a content-centric Internet.
the current Internet can be viewed as a content-centric network.
the Internet is evolving from a network of hosts into a network of content, and that this evolution is already happening.
